### Table 1. Baseline Cohort Characteristics

```{r, include=FALSE}

# Query master table in DB2
Cohort_Master <- db2_run(conn = Connection, query = 'SELECT * FROM SAILW1483V.PRIOR_COMB_COHORT_MASTER_LLT')

# Transformations
colnames(Cohort_Master)[6] <- 'Sex'
Cohort_Master$Sex <- replace(Cohort_Master$Sex, Cohort_Master$Sex == 1, 'Male')
Cohort_Master$Sex <- replace(Cohort_Master$Sex, Cohort_Master$Sex == 2, 'Female')
Cohort_Master$Sex <- replace(Cohort_Master$Sex, Cohort_Master$Sex == 0, NA)
Cohort_Master$Sex <- replace(Cohort_Master$Sex, Cohort_Master$Sex == 3, NA)
Cohort_Master$Sex <- replace(Cohort_Master$Sex, Cohort_Master$Sex == 9, NA)

Cohort_Master$diabetes_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$diabetes_before, Cohort_Master$diabetes_before == '0', '')
Cohort_Master$diabetes_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$diabetes_before, Cohort_Master$diabetes_before == '1', 'Diabetes')

Cohort_Master$dementia_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$dementia_before, Cohort_Master$dementia_before == '0', '')
Cohort_Master$dementia_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$dementia_before, Cohort_Master$dementia_before == '1', 'Dementia')

Cohort_Master$liver_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$liver_before, Cohort_Master$liver_before == '0', '')
Cohort_Master$liver_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$liver_before, Cohort_Master$liver_before == '1', 'Liver Disease')

Cohort_Master$renal_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$renal_before, Cohort_Master$renal_before == '0', '')
Cohort_Master$renal_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$renal_before, Cohort_Master$renal_before == '1', 'CKD')

Cohort_Master$resp_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$resp_before, Cohort_Master$resp_before == '0', '')
Cohort_Master$resp_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$resp_before, Cohort_Master$resp_before == '1', 'Respiratory Disease')

Cohort_Master$af_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$af_before, Cohort_Master$af_before == '0', '')
Cohort_Master$af_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$af_before, Cohort_Master$af_before == '1', 'Atrial fibrillation')

Cohort_Master$hf_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$hf_before, Cohort_Master$hf_before == '0', '')
Cohort_Master$hf_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$hf_before, Cohort_Master$hf_before == '1', 'Heart failure')

Cohort_Master$hypertension_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$hypertension_before, Cohort_Master$hypertension_before == '0', '')
Cohort_Master$hypertension_before <- replace(Cohort_Master$hypertension_before, Cohort_Master$hypertension_before == '1', 'Hypertension')

Cohort_Master$high_risk <- replace(Cohort_Master$high_risk, Cohort_Master$high_risk == '0', '')
Cohort_Master$high_risk <- replace(Cohort_Master$high_risk, Cohort_Master$high_risk == '1', 'Diabetes, Hypertension or CKD')

Cohort_Master$Comorbidities <- paste(Cohort_Master$diabetes_before, Cohort_Master$dementia_before, Cohort_Master$liver_before, Cohort_Master$renal_before, Cohort_Master$resp_before, Cohort_Master$af_before, Cohort_Master$hf_before, Cohort_Master$hypertension_before, sep=' ')

Cohort_Master$smoking_status <- ifelse(is.na(Cohort_Master$smoking_status), 'UN', Cohort_Master$smoking_status)
Cohort_Master$smoking_status <- replace(Cohort_Master$smoking_status, Cohort_Master$smoking_status == 'E', 'Ex-smoker')
Cohort_Master$smoking_status <- replace(Cohort_Master$smoking_status, Cohort_Master$smoking_status == 'N', 'Non-smoker')
Cohort_Master$smoking_status <- replace(Cohort_Master$smoking_status, Cohort_Master$smoking_status == 'S', 'Active smoker')
Cohort_Master$smoking_status <- replace(Cohort_Master$smoking_status, Cohort_Master$smoking_status == 'UN', 'Unknown')

Cohort_Master$weight_cat <- ifelse(is.na(Cohort_Master$weight_cat), 'UN', Cohort_Master$weight_cat)

Cohort_Master$weight_cat <- replace(Cohort_Master$weight_cat, Cohort_Master$weight_cat == 'OW', 'Overweight')
Cohort_Master$weight_cat <- replace(Cohort_Master$weight_cat, Cohort_Master$weight_cat == 'UW', 'Underweight')
Cohort_Master$weight_cat <- replace(Cohort_Master$weight_cat, Cohort_Master$weight_cat == 'N', 'Normal weight')
Cohort_Master$weight_cat <- replace(Cohort_Master$weight_cat, Cohort_Master$weight_cat == 'NORM', 'Normal weight')
Cohort_Master$weight_cat <- replace(Cohort_Master$weight_cat, Cohort_Master$weight_cat == 'OB', 'Obese')
Cohort_Master$weight_cat <- replace(Cohort_Master$weight_cat, Cohort_Master$weight_cat == 'UN', 'Unknown')

Cohort_Master$type <- factor(Cohort_Master$type, levels= c('Non-fatal - Coronary', 'Non-fatal - Cerebrovascular', 'Fatal - Coronary', 'Fatal - Cerebrovascular'))

Cohort_Master$weight_cat <- factor(Cohort_Master$weight_cat, levels= c('Obese', 'Overweight', 'Normal weight', 'Underweight', 'Unknown'))

Cohort_Master$age_cat <- case_when(Cohort_Master$age_diag < 65 ~ '< 65',
                                     Cohort_Master$age_diag >= 65 & Cohort_Master$age_diag < 75 ~ '65 - 74',
                                     Cohort_Master$age_diag >= 75 & Cohort_Master$age_diag < 85 ~ '75 - 84',
                                     Cohort_Master$age_diag >= 85 ~ '>= 85')

Cohort_Master$age_cat <- factor(Cohort_Master$age_cat, levels= c('< 65', '65 - 74', '75 - 84', '>= 85'))


Cohort_Master$morb <- ifelse(Cohort_Master$diabetes_before == 'Diabetes' & 
                            Cohort_Master$hypertension_before == 'Hypertension' & 
                            Cohort_Master$renal_before == 'CKD', 
                          'Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)',
                                    ifelse(Cohort_Master$diabetes_before == 'Diabetes' & 
                                             Cohort_Master$hypertension_before == 'Hypertension', 
                                           'Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)',
                                          ifelse(Cohort_Master$diabetes_before == 'Diabetes' & 
                                                   Cohort_Master$renal_before == 'CKD', 
                                                 'Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)',
                                                 ifelse(Cohort_Master$hypertension_before == 'Hypertension' & 
                                                          Cohort_Master$renal_before == 'CKD', 
                                                        'Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)',
                                                        ifelse(Cohort_Master$diabetes_before == 'Diabetes', 
                                                               'Diabetes only',
                                                               ifelse(Cohort_Master$hypertension_before == 'Hypertension', 
                                                                      'Hypertension only',
                                                                      ifelse(Cohort_Master$renal_before == 'CKD', 
                                                                             'CKD only',
                                                                             'No DRF')))))))

Multi <- Cohort_Master %>% filter(morb == 'Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)')
mean(Multi$age_diag)
sd(Multi$age_diag)

NoDRF <- Cohort_Master %>% filter(morb == 'No DRF')
mean(NoDRF$age_diag)
sd(NoDRF$age_diag)

Cohort_Master$morb <- factor(Cohort_Master$morb, levels = c('Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)','Diabetes only','Hypertension only','CKD only','No DRF'))

```

```{r, include=FALSE}

tab_comb1 <- cbind(tab_overall, tab_MULTI[2])
tab_comb2 <- cbind(tab_DM[1:2], tab_HTN[2], tab_CKD[2], tab_NONE[2])

names(tab_comb1)[1] <- 'Characteristic'
names(tab_comb1)[2] <- 'All patients'
names(tab_comb1)[3] <- 'Multimorbidity (2+ DRF)'

names(tab_comb2)[1] <- 'Characteristic'
names(tab_comb2)[2] <- 'Diabetes only'
names(tab_comb2)[3] <- 'Hypertension only'
names(tab_comb2)[4] <- 'CKD (stage 3+) only'
names(tab_comb2)[5] <- 'No DRF'

tab_comb1[13,1] <- ''
tab_comb1[14,1] <- 'Prescribed within year prior'

tab_comb1 <- tab_comb1 %>% filter(trimws(`All patients`) != '', trimws(Characteristic) != 'Female', !is.na(Characteristic))
tab_comb1 <- rbind(tab_comb1[1,], tab_comb1[2:nrow(tab_comb1),] %>% filter(trimws(Characteristic) != ''))

tab_comb2[13,1] <- ''
tab_comb2[14,1] <- 'Prescribed within year prior'

tab_comb2 <- tab_comb2 %>% filter(trimws(`Diabetes only`) != '', trimws(Characteristic) != 'Female', !is.na(Characteristic))
tab_comb2 <- rbind(tab_comb2[1,], tab_comb2[2:nrow(tab_comb2),] %>% filter(trimws(Characteristic) != ''))

tab_comb <- cbind(tab_comb1[1:2], tab_comb2[5:2], tab_comb1[3])

tab_comb <-  tab_comb %>% filter(!`All patients` == '0 (0%)')
tab_comb <-  tab_comb %>% filter(!`All patients` == '4 (0%)')

tab_comb$`Diabetes only`[tab_comb$`Diabetes only` %like% '100%'] <- '-'
tab_comb$`Diabetes only`[tab_comb$`Diabetes only` == '0 (0%)'] <- '-'
tab_comb$`Hypertension only`[tab_comb$`Hypertension only` %like% '100%'] <- '-'
tab_comb$`Hypertension only`[tab_comb$`Hypertension only` == '0 (0%)'] <- '-'
tab_comb$`CKD (stage 3+) only`[tab_comb$`CKD (stage 3+) only` %like% '100%'] <- '-'
tab_comb$`CKD (stage 3+) only`[tab_comb$`CKD (stage 3+) only` == '0 (0%)'] <- '-'
tab_comb$`No DRF`[tab_comb$`No DRF` %like% '100%'] <- '-'
tab_comb$`No DRF`[tab_comb$`No DRF` == '0 (0%)'] <- '-'

```

### Risk factor management

```{r, include=FALSE}

# Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)

LDL <- db2_run(conn = Connection, query = "SELECT * FROM SAILW1483V.TEMP_LDL_CONTROL_PRIOR_COMB_MORBS WHERE morb = 'MULTI'")

LDL_comb <- LDL %>% mutate(year = year(first_date))

LDL_comb_overall <- LDL_comb %>% group_by(test_ctrl) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% mutate(year = 'Overall')
LDL_comb_gap <- LDL_comb %>% group_by(year, test_ctrl) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% mutate(year = ' ', n = 0)
LDL_comb_years <- LDL_comb %>% group_by(year, test_ctrl) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% mutate(year = as.character(year))

Per_Year_LDL_MULTI <- rbind(LDL_comb_overall, LDL_comb_gap, LDL_comb_years)

colnames(Per_Year_LDL_MULTI)[1] <- 'LDL-C'
colnames(Per_Year_LDL_MULTI)[2] <- 'Count'
colnames(Per_Year_LDL_MULTI)[3] <- 'Year'

Per_Year_LDL_MULTI[Per_Year_LDL_MULTI == '<1.8'] <- 'Tested (<1.8)'
Per_Year_LDL_MULTI[Per_Year_LDL_MULTI == '1.8 to <2.6'] <- 'Tested (1.8 - 2.5)'
Per_Year_LDL_MULTI[Per_Year_LDL_MULTI == '>= 2.6'] <- 'Tested (>=2.6)'
Per_Year_LDL_MULTI[Per_Year_LDL_MULTI == 'NOT'] <- 'Not tested'

Per_Year_LDL_MULTI <- Per_Year_LDL_MULTI %>% group_by(Year, `LDL-C`) %>% summarise(Count = sum(Count))

Per_Year_LDL_MULTI$`LDL-C` <- factor(Per_Year_LDL_MULTI$`LDL-C`, levels= c('Not tested', 'Tested (>=2.6)', 'Tested (1.8 - 2.5)','Tested (<1.8)'))
Per_Year_LDL_MULTI$Year <- factor(Per_Year_LDL_MULTI$Year, levels= c('Overall',' ','2010','2011','2012','2013','2014','2015','2016','2017','2018','2019','2020','2021','2022','2023'))

```

```{r, include=FALSE}

LLT <- db2_run(conn = Connection, query = "SELECT DRUG_YR AS YEAR, LLT, COUNT(LLT) AS LLT FROM SAILW1483V.TEMP_INC_LLT_PRIOR_COMB WHERE morb = 'MULTI' GROUP BY DRUG_YR, LLT ORDER BY DRUG_YR, LLT")

LLT$llt <- replace(LLT$llt, LLT$llt == 'HIGH_STATIN', 'Combination or HI statin')
LLT$llt <- replace(LLT$llt, LLT$llt == 'LOW_STATIN', 'NI statin or other')
LLT$llt <- replace(LLT$llt, LLT$llt == 'NOTX', 'No treatment')
LLT$llt <- replace(LLT$llt, LLT$llt == 'INEGY', 'Combination or HI statin')
LLT$llt <- replace(LLT$llt, LLT$llt == 'STATIN_COMBI', 'Combination or HI statin')
LLT$llt <- replace(LLT$llt, LLT$llt == 'OTHER', 'NI statin or other')

LLT_comb_overall <- LLT %>% group_by(llt) %>% summarise(n=sum(llt_1)) %>% mutate(year = 'Overall')
LLT_comb_gap <- LLT %>% group_by(year, llt) %>% summarise(n=sum(llt_1)) %>% mutate(year = ' ', n = 0)
LLT_comb_years <- LLT %>% group_by(year, llt) %>% summarise(n=sum(llt_1)) %>% mutate(year = as.character(year))

Per_Year_LLT_MULTI <- rbind(LLT_comb_overall, LLT_comb_gap, LLT_comb_years)

colnames(Per_Year_LLT_MULTI)[1] <- 'LLT'
colnames(Per_Year_LLT_MULTI)[2] <- 'Count'
colnames(Per_Year_LLT_MULTI)[3] <- 'Year'
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
Per_Year_BP_CKD <- rbind(BP_comb_overall, BP_comb_gap, BP_comb_years)

colnames(Per_Year_BP_CKD)[1] <- 'Blood pressure'
colnames(Per_Year_BP_CKD)[2] <- 'Count'
colnames(Per_Year_BP_CKD)[3] <- 'Year'

Per_Year_BP_CKD$Count[Per_Year_BP_CKD$Count < 10 & Per_Year_BP_CKD$Year != ' '] <- 10

Per_Year_BP_CKD[Per_Year_BP_CKD == 'TEST'] <- 'Tested (>=140 or 90)'
Per_Year_BP_CKD[Per_Year_BP_CKD == 'CTRL'] <- 'Tested (<140 and 90)'
Per_Year_BP_CKD[Per_Year_BP_CKD == 'NOT'] <- 'Not tested'

Per_Year_BP_CKD <- Per_Year_BP_CKD %>% group_by(Year, `Blood pressure`) %>% summarise(Count = sum(Count))

Per_Year_BP_CKD$`Blood pressure` <- factor(Per_Year_BP_CKD$`Blood pressure`, levels= c('Not tested', 'Tested (>=140 or 90)', 'Tested (<140 and 90)'))
Per_Year_BP_CKD$Year <- factor(Per_Year_BP_CKD$Year, levels= c('Overall',' ','2010','2011','2012','2013','2014','2015','2016','2017','2018','2019','2020','2021','2022','2023'))

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=3.5, fig.align = 'center', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Per_Year_LLT_all <- rbind(
                          Per_Year_LLT_MULTI %>% filter(Year == 'Overall') %>% mutate(DRF = '2+ DRF'),
                          Per_Year_LLT_DM %>% filter(Year == 'Overall') %>% mutate(DRF = 'DM'),
                          Per_Year_LLT_HTN %>% filter(Year == 'Overall') %>% mutate(DRF = 'Htn'),
                          Per_Year_LLT_CKD %>% filter(Year == 'Overall') %>% mutate(DRF = 'CKD'),
                          Per_Year_LLT_NONE %>% filter(Year == 'Overall') %>% mutate(DRF = 'No DRF')
                          )

Per_Year_LLT_all$DRF <- factor(Per_Year_LLT_all$DRF, levels = c('No DRF', 'CKD', 'Htn', 'DM', '2+ DRF'))

Per_Year_LLT_all$LLT <- as.character(Per_Year_LLT_all$LLT)
Per_Year_LLT_all$LLT <- case_when(Per_Year_LLT_all$LLT == 'Not treated' ~ 'No treatment',
                                  Per_Year_LLT_all$LLT == 'Treated' ~ 'Any treatment',
                                  Per_Year_LLT_all$LLT == 'Combination statin' ~ 'Combination or HI statin',
                                  Per_Year_LLT_all$LLT == 'HI statin' ~ 'Combination or HI statin',
                                  Per_Year_LLT_all$LLT == 'NI statin or other' ~ 'NI statin or other treatment',
                                  Per_Year_LLT_all$LLT == 'NI statin' ~ 'NI statin or other treatment',
                                  Per_Year_LLT_all$LLT == 'Other treatment' ~ 'NI statin or other treatment',
                                  TRUE ~ Per_Year_LLT_all$LLT)

Per_Year_LLT_all$LLT <- factor(Per_Year_LLT_all$LLT, levels = c('No treatment',
                                                                'NI statin or other treatment',
                                                                'Combination or HI statin',
                                                                'Any treatment'
                                                                ))

labs(x = 'Diagnostic risk factor (DRF)', y = NULL, color = 'Legend', tag = 'D') +

theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust=0.5), panel.border = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.title = element_text(size = 11), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10), axis.text.y = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(size = 10), legend.title = element_text(size = 11), axis.line.x = element_line(), axis.line.y = element_line(), panel.background = element_blank(), legend.position = 'right')
```

### Indicated vs coded DRF

```{r, include=FALSE}

HR <- db2_run(conn = Connection, query = "SELECT * FROM SAILW1483V.TEMP_HIGH_RISK_READINGS_3YR WHERE TYPE <> 'LDL'")

#Rename columns
names(HR)[names(HR)=='year'] <- 'Year'
names(HR)[names(HR)=='type'] <- 'Risk factor'
names(HR)[names(HR)=='cat'] <- 'Documentation'
names(HR)[names(HR)=='count'] <- 'Count'

HR$Documentation <- replace(HR$Documentation, HR$Documentation == 'HIGH', 'Tested - Indicating DRF')
HR$Documentation <- replace(HR$Documentation, HR$Documentation == 'TEST', 'Tested - Not indicating DRF')
HR$Documentation <- replace(HR$Documentation, HR$Documentation == 'NO TEST', 'Not tested')


HR_overall <- HR %>% group_by(`Risk factor`, Documentation) %>% summarise(Count = sum(Count)) %>% mutate(Year = 'Overall')
HR_gap <- HR %>% group_by(Year, `Risk factor`, Documentation) %>% summarise(Count = sum(Count)) %>% mutate(Year = ' ', Count = 0)
HR_years <- HR %>% group_by(Year, `Risk factor`, Documentation) %>% summarise(Count = sum(Count)) %>% mutate(Year = as.character(Year))


HR_any <- db2_run(conn = Connection, query = "SELECT * FROM SAILW1483V.TEMP_HIGH_RISK_READINGS_ANY_3YR")

#Rename columns
names(HR_any)[names(HR_any)=='year'] <- 'Year'
names(HR_any)[names(HR_any)=='cat'] <- 'Documentation'
names(HR_any)[names(HR_any)=='count'] <- 'Count'

HR_any$Documentation <- replace(HR_any$Documentation, HR_any$Documentation == 'HIGH', 'Tested - Indicating DRF')
HR_any$Documentation <- replace(HR_any$Documentation, HR_any$Documentation == 'TEST', 'Tested - Not indicating DRF')
HR_any$Documentation <- replace(HR_any$Documentation, HR_any$Documentation == 'NO TEST', 'Not tested')

HR_overall_any <- HR_any %>% group_by(Documentation) %>% summarise(Count = sum(Count)) %>% mutate(Year = 'Overall', `Risk factor` = 'Any')
HR_years_any <- HR_any %>% group_by(Year, Documentation) %>% summarise(Count = sum(Count)) %>% mutate(Year = as.character(Year), `Risk factor` = 'Any')


HR_all <- rbind(HR_overall, HR_overall_any, HR_gap, HR_years, HR_years_any)
HR_all <- HR_all %>% group_by(Year, `Risk factor`, Documentation) %>% summarise(Count = sum(Count))

HR_all$Documentation <- factor(HR_all$Documentation, levels= c('Not tested','Tested - Indicating DRF', 'Tested - Not indicating DRF'))
HR_all$`Risk factor` <- factor(HR_all$`Risk factor`, levels= c('Any','HbA1c', 'BP', 'eGFR'))
HR_all$Year <- factor(HR_all$Year, levels= c('Overall',' ', '2010','2011','2012','2013','2014','2015','2016','2017','2018','2019','2020','2021','2022','2023'))

HR_all$Count[HR_all$Count < 10 & HR_all$Year != ' '] <- 10

```

```{r, include=FALSE}

LDL_HR_no_diag <- db2_run(conn = Connection, query = "SELECT YEAR(R.FIRST_DATE) AS YEAR, R.TYPE, TEST_CTRL FROM SAILW1483V.TEMP_RISK_READINGS_3YR R JOIN SAILW1483V.TEMP_LDL_CONTROL_PRIOR_COMB_MORBS L USING(ALF_PE) WHERE HIGH = 1")

Per_Year_LDL_HR_no_diag <- LDL_HR_no_diag %>% group_by(year, type, test_ctrl) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% mutate(diag = 'Indicating', type = case_when(type == 'BP' ~ 'HTN', type == 'HbA1c' ~ 'DM', type == 'eGFR' ~ 'CKD'))


LDL_HR_diag <- db2_run(conn = Connection, query = "SELECT YEAR(FIRST_DATE) AS YEAR, TEST_CTRL, DM, HTN, CKD FROM SAILW1483V.TEMP_LDL_CONTROL_PRIOR_COMB_MORBS WHERE DM = 1 OR HTN = 1 OR CKD = 1")

LDL_DM_diag <- LDL_HR_diag %>% filter(dm == 1) %>% group_by(year, test_ctrl) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% mutate(diag = 'Diagnosed', type = 'DM')
LDL_HTN_diag <- LDL_HR_diag %>% filter(htn == 1) %>% group_by(year, test_ctrl) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% mutate(diag = 'Diagnosed', type = 'HTN')
LDL_CKD_diag <- LDL_HR_diag %>% filter(ckd == 1) %>% group_by(year, test_ctrl) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% mutate(diag = 'Diagnosed', type = 'CKD')

Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag <- rbind(Per_Year_LDL_HR_no_diag, LDL_DM_diag, LDL_HTN_diag, LDL_CKD_diag) %>% mutate(year = as.character(year))

LDL_comb_gap <- Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag %>% group_by(year, test_ctrl, diag, type) %>% summarise(n=sum(n)) %>% mutate(year = ' ', n = 0)
LDL_comb_overall <- Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag %>% group_by(test_ctrl, diag, type) %>% summarise(n=sum(n)) %>% mutate(year = 'Overall')

Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag <- rbind(LDL_comb_overall, LDL_comb_gap, Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag)

colnames(Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag)[1] <- 'LDL-C'
colnames(Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag)[2] <- 'Type'
colnames(Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag)[3] <- 'DRF'
colnames(Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag)[4] <- 'Count'
colnames(Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag)[5] <- 'Year'

Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C`[Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C` == '<1.8'] <- 'Tested (<1.8)'
Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C`[Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C` == '1.8 to <2.6'] <- 'Tested (1.8 - 2.5)'
Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C`[Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C` == '>= 2.6'] <- 'Tested (>=2.6)'
Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C`[Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C` == 'NOT'] <- 'Not tested'

Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag <- Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag %>% group_by(Year, Type, `LDL-C`, DRF) %>% summarise(Count = sum(Count))

Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C` <- factor(Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C`, levels= c('Not tested', 'Tested (>=2.6)', 'Tested (1.8 - 2.5)','Tested (<1.8)'))
Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$Type <- factor(Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$Type, levels= c('Indicating', 'Diagnosed'))
Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$DRF <- factor(Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$DRF, levels= c('DM', 'HTN', 'CKD'))
Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$Year <- factor(Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$Year, levels= c('Overall',' ','2010','2011','2012','2013','2014','2015','2016','2017','2018','2019','2020','2021','2022','2023'))

Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag_copy <- data.frame(Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag)

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=8.5, fig.align = 'center', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C` <- replace(Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C`, Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$Type == 'Indicating' & 
                                                              Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C` == 'Tested (>=2.6)', 'Tested')
Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C` <- factor(Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$`LDL-C`, levels= c('Not tested', 'Tested (>=2.6)', 'Tested (1.8 - 2.5)', 'Tested (<1.8)', 'Tested'))

Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag <- Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag %>% group_by(Year, Type, `LDL-C`, DRF) %>% summarise(Count = sum(Count))

Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$Count[Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$Type == 'Indicating' & Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$DRF == 'DM' & Per_Year_LDL_HR_diag$Year != 'Overall'] <- 0
```

#### By Age

```{r, include=FALSE}

LDL <- db2_run(conn = Connection, query = "SELECT L.*, M.AGE_DIAG FROM SAILW1483V.TEMP_LDL_CONTROL_PRIOR_COMB_MORBS L JOIN SAILW1483V.PRIOR_COMB_COHORT_MASTER_LLT M USING(ALF_PE)")

LDL_comb <- LDL %>% mutate(year = year(first_date), age_cat = case_when(age_diag < 50 ~ '< 50',
                                                                        age_diag >= 50 & age_diag < 65 ~ '50 - 64',
                                                                        age_diag >= 65 & age_diag < 75 ~ '65 - 74',
                                                                        age_diag >= 75 & age_diag < 85 ~ '75 - 84',
                                                                        age_diag >= 85 ~ '>= 85'))


LDL_comb_gap <- LDL_comb %>% group_by(year, test_ctrl, age_cat) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% mutate(year = ' ', n = 0)
LDL_comb_years <- LDL_comb %>% group_by(year, test_ctrl, age_cat) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% mutate(year = as.character(year))

LDL_comb_years$n[LDL_comb_years$n < 10] <- 10
LDL_comb_overall <- LDL_comb_years %>% group_by(test_ctrl, age_cat) %>% summarise(n=sum(n)) %>% mutate(year = 'Overall')

Per_Year_LDL_ages <- rbind(LDL_comb_overall, LDL_comb_gap, LDL_comb_years)

colnames(Per_Year_LDL_ages)[1] <- 'LDL-C'
colnames(Per_Year_LDL_ages)[2] <- 'Age'
colnames(Per_Year_LDL_ages)[3] <- 'Count'
colnames(Per_Year_LDL_ages)[4] <- 'Year'

Per_Year_LDL_ages[Per_Year_LDL_ages == '<1.8'] <- 'Tested (<1.8)'
Per_Year_LDL_ages[Per_Year_LDL_ages == '1.8 to <2.6'] <- 'Tested (1.8 - 2.5)'
Per_Year_LDL_ages[Per_Year_LDL_ages == '>= 2.6'] <- 'Tested (>=2.6)'
Per_Year_LDL_ages[Per_Year_LDL_ages == 'NOT'] <- 'Not tested'

Per_Year_LDL_ages$`LDL-C` <- factor(Per_Year_LDL_ages$`LDL-C`, levels= c('Not tested', 'Tested (>=2.6)', 'Tested (1.8 - 2.5)','Tested (<1.8)'))
Per_Year_LDL_ages$Age <- factor(Per_Year_LDL_ages$Age, levels= c('< 50','50 - 64', '65 - 74', '75 - 84', '>= 85'))
Per_Year_LDL_ages$Year <- factor(Per_Year_LDL_ages$Year, levels= c('Overall',' ','2010','2011','2012','2013','2014','2015','2016','2017','2018','2019','2020','2021','2022','2023'))

```

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLT <- db2_run(conn = Connection, query = "SELECT L.*, M.AGE_DIAG FROM SAILW1483V.TEMP_INC_LLT_PRIOR_COMB L JOIN SAILW1483V.PRIOR_COMB_COHORT_MASTER_LLT M USING(ALF_PE)")

LLT$llt <- replace(LLT$llt, LLT$llt == 'HIGH_STATIN', 'Combination or HI statin')
LLT$llt <- replace(LLT$llt, LLT$llt == 'LOW_STATIN', 'NI statin or other')
LLT$llt <- replace(LLT$llt, LLT$llt == 'NOTX', 'No treatment')
LLT$llt <- replace(LLT$llt, LLT$llt == 'INEGY', 'Combination or HI statin')
LLT$llt <- replace(LLT$llt, LLT$llt == 'STATIN_COMBI', 'Combination or HI statin')
LLT$llt <- replace(LLT$llt, LLT$llt == 'OTHER', 'NI statin or other')

LLT <- LLT %>% mutate(year = drug_yr, age_cat = case_when(age_diag < 50 ~ '< 50',
                                                                        age_diag >= 50 & age_diag < 65 ~ '50 - 64',

                                                                        age_diag >= 75 & age_diag < 85 ~ '75 - 84',

LLT_comb_years <- LLT %>% group_by(year, llt, age_cat) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% mutate(year = as.character(year))

LLT_comb_years$n[LLT_comb_years$n < 10] <- 10
```

#### LDL levels

```{r, include=FALSE}

MIN_LDL_Test <- db2_run(conn = Connection, query = "SELECT 
YEAR(FIRST_DATE) AS event_year, 
MORB,
CASE WHEN MIN_LDL >= 5 OR TEST_CTRL = 'NOT' THEN 5 ELSE MIN_LDL END AS MIN_LDL
FROM SAILW1483V.TEMP_LDL_CONTROL_PRIOR_COMB_MORBS")

```

```{r, include=FALSE}

L<-seq(0,4.5,0.001)

LDL_min_MULTI <- MIN_LDL_Test %>% filter(morb == 'MULTI') 
y <- ecdf(LDL_min_MULTI$min_ldl)(L)
LDL_min_MULTI <-data.frame(L,y, morb = 'Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)')

LDL_min_DM <- MIN_LDL_Test %>% filter(morb == 'DM') 
y <- ecdf(LDL_min_DM$min_ldl)(L)
LDL_min_DM <-data.frame(L,y, morb = 'Diabetes only')

LDL_min_HTN <- MIN_LDL_Test %>% filter(morb == 'HTN') 
y <- ecdf(LDL_min_HTN$min_ldl)(L)
LDL_min_HTN <-data.frame(L,y, morb = 'Hypertension only')

LDL_min_CKD <- MIN_LDL_Test %>% filter(morb == 'CKD') 
y <- ecdf(LDL_min_CKD$min_ldl)(L)
LDL_min_CKD <-data.frame(L,y, morb = 'CKD only')

LDL_min_NONE <- MIN_LDL_Test %>% filter(morb == 'NONE') 
y <- ecdf(LDL_min_NONE$min_ldl)(L)
LDL_min_NONE <-data.frame(L,y, morb = 'No DRF')

LDL_min <- rbind(LDL_min_MULTI, LDL_min_DM, LDL_min_HTN, LDL_min_CKD, LDL_min_NONE)
LDL_min$morb <- factor(LDL_min$morb, levels= c('Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)', 'Diabetes only', 'Hypertension only', 'CKD only', 'No DRF'))

geom_hline(data = hline_df, aes(yintercept = y_intercept26), linetype="dashed", colour = cbPalette[2])+
```

#### BP levels

```{r, include=FALSE}

MIN_BP_Test <- db2_run(conn = Connection, query = "SELECT 
YEAR(FIRST_DATE) AS event_year, 
CASE WHEN SYS >= 170 OR SYS IS NULL THEN 180 ELSE SYS END AS MIN_SYS,
CASE WHEN DYS >= 100 OR DYS IS NULL THEN 110 ELSE DYS END AS MIN_DYS,
MORB
FROM SAILW1483V.TEMP_BP_CONTROL_PRIOR_COMB_MORBS
WHERE SYS > 0 OR SYS IS NULL")

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=10, fig.align = 'center', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

L<-seq(40,170,0.1)

BP_min_MULTI <- MIN_BP_Test %>% filter(morb == 'MULTI') 
y_dys <- ecdf(BP_min_MULTI$min_dys)(L)
y_sys <- ecdf(BP_min_MULTI$min_sys)(L)
BP_min_MULTI <-data.frame(L,y_dys, y_sys, morb = 'Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)') %>% mutate(y_dys = ifelse(L >= 105, NA, y_dys))

BP_min_DM <- MIN_BP_Test %>% filter(morb == 'DM') 
y_dys <- ecdf(BP_min_DM$min_dys)(L)
y_sys <- ecdf(BP_min_DM$min_sys)(L)

y_sys <- ecdf(BP_min_HTN$min_sys)(L)

y_sys <- ecdf(BP_min_CKD$min_sys)(L)

y_sys <- ecdf(BP_min_NONE$min_sys)(L)

                  data.frame(morb = 'Hypertension only', y_intercept_sys = BP_min_HTN$y_sys[1001], y_intercept_dys = BP_min_HTN$y_dys[501]),
                  data.frame(morb = 'CKD only', y_intercept_sys = BP_min_CKD$y_sys[1001], y_intercept_dys = BP_min_CKD$y_dys[501]),
                  data.frame(morb = 'No DRF', y_intercept_sys = BP_min_NONE$y_sys[1001], y_intercept_dys = BP_min_NONE$y_dys[501]))
hline_df$morb <- factor(hline_df$morb, levels= c('Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)', 'Diabetes only', 'Hypertension only', 'CKD only', 'No DRF'))

shaded_bottom <- rbind(data.frame(morb = 'Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)', y_intercept = BP_min_MULTI$y_sys[BP_min_MULTI$L == 169.9]),
```

### Base tables 

```{r, include=FALSE}

add_pct_matrix <- function(base_df, var_df, group_var, year_var = "Year", value_var = "Count", format_pct = TRUE, include_total = FALSE) {
  
  # Base summarised data
  base <- var_df %>%
    filter(.data[[year_var]] != ' ') %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c(year_var, group_var)))) %>%
    summarise(Count = sum(.data[[value_var]]), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Wide format of counts
  wide_counts <- base %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = all_of(year_var), values_from = Count) %>%
    arrange(.data[[group_var]])
  
  # Total per year
  total <- var_df %>%
    filter(.data[[year_var]] != ' ') %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(year_var))) %>%
    summarise(Total = sum(.data[[value_var]]), .groups = "drop")
  
  total_wide <- pivot_wider(total, names_from = all_of(year_var), values_from = Total)
  
  # Create percentage table
  pct <- left_join(base, total, by = year_var) %>%
    mutate(pct_tested = round((Count / Total) * 100, 1))
  
  pct_wide <- pct %>%
    select(all_of(group_var), year = all_of(year_var), pct_tested) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = pct_tested) %>%
    arrange(.data[[group_var]])
  
  # Format as matrix of percentage strings
    pct_wide[] <- lapply(pct_wide, function(x) {
      if (is.numeric(x)) {
        str_replace_all(paste0("(", format(x, nsmall = 1), "%)"), " ", "")
      } else {
        x
      }
    })
    
    out_matrix <- matrix(
      paste0(as.matrix(wide_counts[-1]), ' ', as.matrix(pct_wide[-1])),
      nrow = nrow(wide_counts)
    )
    
    total_wide <- cbind(data.frame(Name = ' '), total_wide)
    out_df <- cbind(wide_counts[[group_var]], data.frame(out_matrix))
    colnames(out_df) <- c(as.character(colnames(base_df)))
    
    if(include_total == TRUE) {
    comb_df <- rbind(total_wide, out_df)
    final_df <- rbind(base_df, comb_df)
    
    return(final_df)
    }

    return(rbind(base_df, out_df))
}

```


#### LDL Test  

```{r, include=FALSE}

LDL <- db2_run(conn = Connection, query = "SELECT * FROM SAILW1483V.TEMP_LDL_CONTROL_PRIOR_COMB_MORBS")

LDL_comb <- LDL %>% mutate(Year = year(first_date))
LDL_comb_overall <- LDL_comb %>% group_by(test_ctrl) %>% summarise(Count=n()) %>% mutate(Year = 'Overall')
LDL_comb_years <- LDL_comb %>% group_by(Year, test_ctrl) %>% summarise(Count=n()) %>% mutate(Year = as.character(Year))
Per_Year_LDL <- rbind(LDL_comb_overall, LDL_comb_years)

colnames(Per_Year_LDL)[1] <- 'LDL-C'
colnames(Per_Year_LDL)[2] <- 'Count'
colnames(Per_Year_LDL)[3] <- 'Year'

Per_Year_LDL[Per_Year_LDL == '<1.8'] <- 'Tested (<1.8)'
Per_Year_LDL[Per_Year_LDL == '1.8 to <2.6'] <- 'Tested (1.8 - 2.5)'
Per_Year_LDL[Per_Year_LDL == '>= 2.6'] <- 'Tested (>=2.6)'
Per_Year_LDL[Per_Year_LDL == 'NOT'] <- 'Not tested'

Per_Year_LDL$Year <- factor(Per_Year_LDL$Year, levels= c('Overall', '2010','2011','2012','2013','2014','2015','2016','2017','2018','2019','2020','2021','2022','2023'))
Per_Year_LDL$`LDL-C` <- factor(Per_Year_LDL$`LDL-C`, levels= c('Not tested', 'Tested (>=2.6)', 'Tested (1.8 - 2.5)','Tested (<1.8)'))

```

#### LDL levels

```{r, include=FALSE}

Insert_mean_of_n <- function(df,n) {
  Mean <- round(t(colSums(df[1:n,2:ncol(df)]))/n,1)
  Mean <- cbind(df[1,1], Mean)
  Mean$Name <- factor(Mean$Name, levels = c('Overall'))
  Mean[1,1] <- 'Overall'
  df <- rbind(Mean, df)
  
  return(df)
}

```

```{r, include=FALSE}

MIN_LDL_Test$morb <- case_when(MIN_LDL_Test$morb == 'MULTI' ~ 'Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)',
                               MIN_LDL_Test$morb == 'DM' ~ 'Diabetes only',
                               MIN_LDL_Test$morb == 'HTN' ~ 'Hypertension only',
                               MIN_LDL_Test$morb == 'CKD' ~ 'CKD only',
                               MIN_LDL_Test$morb == 'NONE' ~ 'No DRF')

MIN_LDL_Test$morb <- factor(MIN_LDL_Test$morb, levels = c('Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)','Diabetes only','Hypertension only','CKD only','No DRF'))

Base_df <- MIN_LDL_Test %>% group_by(event_year, morb) %>% summarise(Mean = round(mean(min_ldl),1)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = event_year, values_from = Mean) %>% mutate(morb = as.character(morb))
colnames(Base_df)[1] <- 'Name'
Base_df <- Insert_mean_of_n(Base_df,5)

LDL_SD <- MIN_LDL_Test %>% group_by(event_year, morb) %>% summarise(sd = round(sd(min_ldl),1))%>% pivot_wider(names_from = event_year, values_from = sd) %>% arrange(morb)
colnames(LDL_SD)[1] <- 'Name'
LDL_SD$Name <- as.character(LDL_SD$Name)
LDL_SD <- Insert_mean_of_n(LDL_SD,5)
LDL_SD <- data.frame(lapply(LDL_SD,function(x) paste0('(', format(x, nsmall=1), ')')))

Base_df[-1] <- matrix(paste0(as.matrix(Base_df[-1]), ' ', as.matrix(LDL_SD[-1])), nrow = nrow(Base_df))

#Replace nulls
Base_df[is.na(Base_df)] <- 0
Base_df_char <- Base_df %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), as.character))
Base_df_char[Base_df_char == '0.0'] <- 'N/A'
Base_df_char$pct<- NULL
colnames(Base_df_char) <- colnames(Base_df)
colnames(Base_df_char)[1] <- ' '

```

```{r, include=FALSE}
                               MIN_BP_Test$morb == 'CKD' ~ 'CKD only',
                               MIN_BP_Test$morb == 'NONE' ~ 'No DRF')

MIN_BP_Test$morb <- factor(MIN_BP_Test$morb, levels = c('Multi-morbidity (2+ DRF)','Diabetes only','Hypertension only','CKD only','No DRF'))

#Systolic
Base_df <- MIN_BP_Test %>% group_by(event_year, morb) %>% summarise(Mean = round(mean(min_sys),0)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = event_year, values_from = Mean) %>% mutate(morb = as.character(morb))

colnames(Base_df)[1] <- 'Name'
Base_df <- Insert_mean_of_n_no_dp(Base_df,5)

BP_SD <- MIN_BP_Test %>% group_by(event_year, morb) %>% summarise(sd = round(sd(min_sys),0))%>% pivot_wider(names_from = event_year, values_from = sd) %>% arrange(morb)
colnames(BP_SD)[1] <- 'Name'
BP_SD$Name <- as.character(BP_SD$Name)

BP_SD <- Insert_mean_of_n_no_dp(BP_SD,5)
BP_SD <- data.frame(lapply(BP_SD,function(x) paste0('(', x, ')')))

Base_df[-1] <- paste0(as.matrix(Base_df[-1]), ' ', as.matrix(BP_SD[-1]))


#Diastolic
Base_df_dys <- MIN_BP_Test %>% group_by(event_year, morb) %>% summarise(Mean = round(mean(min_dys),0)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = event_year, values_from = Mean) %>% mutate(morb = as.character(morb))

colnames(Base_df_dys)[1] <- 'Name'
Base_df_dys <- Insert_mean_of_n_no_dp(Base_df_dys,5)

BP_SD_dys <- MIN_BP_Test %>% group_by(event_year, morb) %>% summarise(sd = round(sd(min_dys),0))%>% pivot_wider(names_from = event_year, values_from = sd) %>% arrange(morb)
colnames(BP_SD_dys)[1] <- 'Name'
BP_SD_dys$Name <- as.character(BP_SD_dys$Name)

BP_SD_dys <- Insert_mean_of_n_no_dp(BP_SD_dys,5)
BP_SD_dys <- data.frame(lapply(BP_SD_dys,function(x) paste0('(', x, ')')))

Base_df_dys[-1] <- paste0(as.matrix(Base_df_dys[-1]), ' ', as.matrix(BP_SD_dys[-1]))

Base_df <- rbind(Base_df, Base_df_dys)

#Replace nulls
Base_df[is.na(Base_df)] <- 0
Base_df_char <- Base_df %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), as.character))
Base_df_char[Base_df_char == '0.0'] <- 'N/A'
Base_df_char$pct<- NULL
colnames(Base_df_char) <- colnames(Base_df)
colnames(Base_df_char)[1] <- ' '

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

Base_df_char %>%
  kbl(caption = 'Suppl Table X. BP levels') %>%
  pack_rows(index = c('Mean (SD) systolic BP'=6,
                      'Mean (SD) diastolic BP (at min systolic)'=6), 
                      label_row_css = 'background-color: #999; color: #fff') %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c('hover','condensed')) %>%
  kable_paper()
```
